Adequate capital; no forced funds decisions. Aging horizon begins at fill.
assumptions.wholesale: Actual PARTNERS rates/ages; no added aroma or reputation bonus. No relationship generation/probability simulated.
assumptions.special: Only actual target-age flavour predicate; relationship/capital/offer/fulfilment gating not simulated.
assumptions.replay: Experiment recipe retains model ID + contract + seed + stop + cask. Main usual-recipe has no experimental model ID and cannot replay A/B.
assumptions.sidecarPricing: Composition ignored by existing prices, demand and special orders; preservable experimental sidecar is not proof it has economic meaning.
